verdict.rationale: Vercel documents on-demand server-side execution via Fluid compute that "scales concurrency" for I/O-heavy workloads, and positions itself as a platform for scaling web apps. A community report of surprise $10k bills during undetected DDoS traffic suggests the platform does absorb bursts automatically, but at uncontrolled cost. The evidence is thin, with only a one-line scaling claim. Missing for 10: detailed docs on load-based scaling behavior and limits (concurrency caps, burst handling, regional scale-out), spend/scaling guardrails for bursts, and independent hands-on corroboration of burst absorption.
